ORDINANCE LVII OF 2001
FOREST
(BALOCHISTAN AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance further
to amend
the Forest Act, 1927
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
22nd January, 2002]
No.Legis.2‑42/Law/79‑IV,
dated 22‑1‑2002.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Balochistan on 28th December, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement. ‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Forest (Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
